# workbench

> A pretend HPC cluster for a 16 GB laptop with a memory governor: real Slurm, fake BMCs, GPUs, Jira and BCM, named faults. Built as a test target for a monitoring client.

## For AI agents

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): start here; commands, endpoints, rules
- [Recipes](docs/agents/recipes/connect-your-app.md): one goal each with exact commands (see the folder docs/agents/recipes/)
- [JSON schemas](docs/agents/schemas/get-nodes.json): one per `--json` output (folder docs/agents/schemas/)
- [JSON contract changelog](docs/agents/CHANGELOG.md): versions and changes
- [Error codes](docs/agents/ERROR-CODES.md): every WB- code with its fix
